outcome: Inter-recti distance (IRD) at the supraumbilical, umbilical, and infraumbilical regions
cohort: 56 primiparous women at nine weeks postpartum.
finding: Neither resistance exercise during pregnancy nor mode of delivery had a significant impact on inter-recti distance at nine weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Type of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) did not significantly impact inter-recti distance at nine weeks postpartum.
